because: 4041 of 4251 rows are one DID: 3695 Wikibooks Cookbook imports (wb-* ids, 3.81% line-miss) plus 346 uniformly clean machine-styled rows (2.78%). The other 39 DIDs hold 210 recipes at 12.21% line-miss / 45.7% recipe-miss. A uniform draw would be 95% one importer and would have reported ~4%. Taking C whole is a census, not a sample, so there is zero opportunity to curate against the matcher -- which is the exact failure this task exists to correct. A slice of A adds no measurement power because A is already measured over all 3695 rows and reported separately; it would only blur what the committed corpus means.
